dispatchBoard.title: Dispatch board
dispatchBoard.subtitle_one: {{count}} delivery open · a delivery leaves only when every check is green
dispatchBoard.subtitle_other: {{count}} deliveries open · a delivery leaves only when every check is green
dispatchBoard.noRight: The dispatch board needs logistics rights. Ask Admin.
dispatchBoard.emptyBody: Schedule a delivery from a confirmed sales order. Its invoice, e-way bill and trip are added here.
dispatchBoard.partNote: Part delivered: the short goods came back to quarantine.
dispatchBoard.failedNote: Not delivered: the goods came back to quarantine and the order is open again.
dispatchBoard.ewayHelp: Enter the 12-digit number generated on the e-way bill portal. Until a value threshold is set by Admin, every delivery needs one before the vehicle leaves.
dispatchBoard.newHelp: Pick a confirmed order. Quantities default to what is still open; the server checks the order, the place and the quantities.
dispatchBoard.nothingOpen: Everything on this order is already scheduled.
